\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ক্যাম্প} (kæmp)}{ক্যাম্প (kæmp)}]{\bn{ক্যাম্প} (kæmp) — a holiday camp; a training camp}

\label{lesson:BN-C523-kemp}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to bend, then the Bengali for wrestling.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ক্যাম্প}}
\textbf{\bn{ক্যাম্প}} — \emph{kæmp} — \textquotedblleft{}a holiday camp; a training camp\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{ছুটিতে} \bn{আমরা} \bn{পাহাড়ে} \bn{একটা} \bn{ক্যাম্পে} \bn{ছিলাম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Chhuṭite āmrā pāhāṛe ekṭā kæmpe chhilām.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
In the holidays we stayed at a camp in the mountains.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ক্যাম্প}} (\emph{kæmp}) is borrowed from English \emph{camp}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kæmp}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kæmp}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Chhuṭite āmrā pāhāṛe ekṭā kæmpe chhilām.} — In the holidays we stayed at a camp in the mountains.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to bend, then the Bengali for wrestling, then say \emph{kæmp} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{ক্যাম্প} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A holiday camp; a training camp\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{দূরবিন} (dūrbin)}{দূরবিন (dūrbin)}]{\bn{দূরবিন} (dūrbin) — binoculars; a telescope}

\label{lesson:BN-C523-durbin}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for wrestling, then the Bengali for a holiday camp.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{দূরবিন}}
\textbf{\bn{দূরবিন}} — \emph{dūrbin} — \textquotedblleft{}binoculars; a telescope\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমি} \bn{দূরবিনে} \bn{দূরের} \bn{পাহাড়} \bn{দেখলাম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmi dūrbine dūrer pāhāṛ dekhlām.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I looked at the far-off mountains through binoculars.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{দূরবিন}} (\emph{dūrbin}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{dūrbīn}, \textquotedblleft{}far-seeing\textquotedblright{}: \emph{dūr}, \textquotedblleft{}far\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{bīn}, \textquotedblleft{}seeing\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dūrbin}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dūrbin}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āmi dūrbine dūrer pāhāṛ dekhlām.} — I looked at the far-off mountains through binoculars.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for wrestling, then the Bengali for a holiday camp, then say \emph{dūrbin} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{দূরবিন} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Binoculars; a telescope\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{পর্বতারোহণ} (pôrbôtārohôn)}{পর্বতারোহণ (pôrbôtārohôn)}]{\bn{পর্বতারোহণ} (pôrbôtārohôn) — mountain climbing}

\label{lesson:BN-C523-porbotarohon}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a holiday camp, then the Bengali for binoculars.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{পর্বতারোহণ}}
\textbf{\bn{পর্বতারোহণ}} — \emph{pôrbôtārohôn} — \textquotedblleft{}mountain climbing\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{পর্বতারোহণ} \bn{একটা} \bn{বিপজ্জনক} \bn{খেলা।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Pôrbôtārohôn ekṭā bipôjjônôk khælā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Mountain climbing is a dangerous sport.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{পর্বতারোহণ}} (\emph{pôrbôtārohôn}) joins Sanskrit \emph{parvata}, \textquotedblleft{}a mountain\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{ārohaṇa}, \textquotedblleft{}ascending\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Pôrbôtārohôn ekṭā bipôjjônôk khælā.} — Mountain climbing is a dangerous sport.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a holiday camp, then the Bengali for binoculars, then say \emph{pôrbôtārohôn} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বঁড়শি} (bõṛshi)}{বঁড়শি (bõṛshi)}]{\bn{বঁড়শি} (bõṛshi) — a fish-hook}

\label{lesson:BN-C523-borshi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for binoculars, then the Bengali for mountain climbing.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বঁড়শি}}
\textbf{\bn{বঁড়শি}} — \emph{bõṛshi} — \textquotedblleft{}a fish-hook\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{জেলে} \bn{বঁড়শিতে} \bn{একটা} \bn{বড়} \bn{মাছ} \bn{ধরল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Jele bõṛshite ekṭā bôṛo māchh dhôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The fisherman caught a big fish on his hook.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বঁড়শি}} (\emph{bõṛshi}) is a tadbhava: CDIAL lists Bengali \emph{bãṛsi}, \textquotedblleft{}a fish-hook\textquotedblright{}, under Sanskrit \emph{baḍiśa}, which Turner thought might be of Munda origin (CDIAL 9123).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bõṛshi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Jele bõṛshite ekṭā bôṛo māchh dhôrlô.} — The fisherman caught a big fish on his hook.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for binoculars, then the Bengali for mountain climbing, then say \emph{bõṛshi} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সাঁতরানো} (sā̃trāno)}{সাঁতরানো (sā̃trāno)}]{\bn{সাঁতরানো} (sā̃trāno) — to swim across}

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Free Time to Into the Outdoors}

\label{lesson:BN-R523-review-516-523}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for entertainment and spare time.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item entertainment, spare time, cycling, absorbed, amateur
  \item a skipping rope, to run after, badminton, hide-and-seek, a marble
  \item ludo, dice, snakes and ladders, a crossword, carrom
  \item the stands, a match, a team captain, a referee, to be beaten
  \item a medal, a trophy, a sporting record, a contestant, to lead to victory
  \item a cricket bat, a wicket, a run in cricket, a catch in cricket, to hit hard
  \item yoga, a strongman, in good shape, to bend, wrestling
  \item a holiday camp, binoculars, mountain climbing, a fish-hook, to swim across
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Entertainment? (\textbf{\bn{বিনোদন}}, \emph{binodôn}.) Spare time? (\textbf{\bn{ফুরসত}}, \emph{phursôt}.) Cycling? (\textbf{\bn{সাইক্লিং}}, \emph{sāikling}.) Absorbed? (\textbf{\bn{মগ্ন}}, \emph{môgnô}.) Amateur? (\textbf{\bn{শৌখিন}}, \emph{shoukhin}.) A skipping rope? (\textbf{\bn{লাফদড়ি}}, \emph{lāphdôṛi}.) To run after? (\textbf{\bn{ধাওয়া} \bn{করা}}, \emph{dhāoyā kôrā}.) Badminton? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যাডমিন্টন}}, \emph{bæḍminṭôn}.) Hide-and-seek? (\textbf{\bn{লুকোচুরি}}, \emph{lukochuri}.) A marble? (\textbf{\bn{মার্বেল}}, \emph{mārbel}.) Ludo? (\textbf{\bn{লুডো}}, \emph{luḍo}.) Dice? (\textbf{\bn{পাশা}}, \emph{pāshā}.) Snakes and ladders? (\textbf{\bn{সাপলুডো}}, \emph{sāpluḍo}.) A crossword? (\textbf{\bn{শব্দজব্দ}}, \emph{shôbdôjôbdô}.) Carrom? (\textbf{\bn{ক্যারম}}, \emph{kærôm}.) The stands? (\textbf{\bn{গ্যালারি}}, \emph{gælāri}.) A match? (\textbf{\bn{ম্যাচ}}, \emph{mæch}.) A team captain? (\textbf{\bn{অধিনায়ক}}, \emph{ôdhināyôk}.) A referee? (\textbf{\bn{রেফারি}}, \emph{rephāri}.) To be beaten? (\textbf{\bn{হারা}}, \emph{hārā}.) A medal? (\textbf{\bn{পদক}}, \emph{pôdôk}.) A trophy? (\textbf{\bn{ট্রফি}}, \emph{ṭrôphi}.) A sporting record? (\textbf{\bn{রেকর্ড}}, \emph{rekôrḍ}.) A contestant? (\textbf{\bn{প্রতিযোগী}}, \emph{prôtijogī}.) To lead to victory? (\textbf{\bn{জেতানো}}, \emph{jetāno}.) A cricket bat? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যাট}}, \emph{bæṭ}.) A wicket? (\textbf{\bn{উইকেট}}, \emph{uikeṭ}.) A run in cricket? (\textbf{\bn{রান}}, \emph{rān}.) A catch in cricket? (\textbf{\bn{ক্যাচ}}, \emph{kæch}.) To hit hard? (\textbf{\bn{পেটানো}}, \emph{peṭāno}.) Yoga? (\textbf{\bn{যোগব্যায়াম}}, \emph{jogbyāyām}.) A strongman? (\textbf{\bn{পালোয়ান}}, \emph{pāloyān}.) In good shape? (\textbf{\bn{ফিট}}, \emph{phiṭ}.) To bend? (\textbf{\bn{বাঁকানো}}, \emph{bā̃kāno}.) Wrestling? (\textbf{\bn{কুস্তি}}, \emph{kusti}.) A holiday camp? (\textbf{\bn{ক্যাম্প}}, \emph{kæmp}.) Binoculars? (\textbf{\bn{দূরবিন}}, \emph{dūrbin}.) Mountain climbing? (\textbf{\bn{পর্বতারোহণ}}, \emph{pôrbôtārohôn}.) A fish-hook? (\textbf{\bn{বঁড়শি}}, \emph{bõṛshi}.) To swim across? (\textbf{\bn{সাঁতরানো}}, \emph{sā̃trāno}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
